text.p: Headlines from major national newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
EL PAIS
- (Basque leader) Ardanza poses a problem for (Prime Minister Jose Maria) Aznar with his absence in the Senate debate
- China tried to influence Clinton with financial donations to his campaign
- Prosecutors association says the rejection of Poyatos (as chief prosecutor) is "intolerable interference"
- 155 detained during a dislodging of "squatters" in Madrid
EL MUNDO
- Hundreds Basque police ask for justice for the man who killed their colleagues
- Only 29,000 of the 740,000 signed in February were fixed
- The decoder of Polanco (CanalSatelite chairman) does not meet the requirements, according to Development Ministry
- PP councillor says that the "squatters" hold "satanic festivals"
DIARIO 16
- Judge Liano tries to imprison Cebrian
- Dozens of squatters detained in Madrid
- Another (judge Baltasar) Garzon witness retracts testimony
ABC
- ETA mafia demands "revolutionary tax" from small businesses
- ETA ringleaders congratulate themselves on having achieved the discrediting of the Basque police
- The PNV, too busy negotiating with ETA: Ardanza will not attend the autonomous region debate
CINCO DIAS
- Air controllers decide to tighten the normal hours; airlines fear delays of up to three hours this week
- Domestic savings boosts the bourse
EXPANSION
- Airtel loses 34 billion on the trade war with Telefonica
- Bourse breaks another record with a 1.81 percent climb
- Rato announces new measures to reduce small business taxes
- Nissan to invest 100 billion pesetas in Spain
GACETA DE LOS NEGOCIOS
- Telefonica, banks and electricity utilities carry the bourse to a new record
- February unemployment confirms the urgency of labour reform
